verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe self-hosting, export/import, and bot development (zulip-docs-18, zulip-docs-6, zulip-docs-25) but nowhere mention a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or test organization that isolates AI-native testing from production data. Since Zulip is a self-hostable platform with an API and bot framework, such a sandbox capability would be a fair thing to expect, but no evidence in the pack shows it exists.
